svg.title: Inside the Triangulator collector
svg.desc: UDP datagrams from the sampler are received and checked, assembled into ticks by session and sequence, turned into per-thread state, then split into five-second rollups stored in SQLite day files and a ten-minute in-memory window. Health and resource samples join a JSON snapshot published every half second, which the HTTP server serves to the dashboard.

g.text: One pass from raw UDP chunks to stored history and a live snapshot. Each stage is labelled with its file in collector/.
Blue: raw datagrams. Green: thread state. Amber: stored rollups. Violet: views for the browser.
